HOUSING AND PUBLIC HEALTH COMMITTEE AGENDA
  TUESDAY, MAY 19, 2026
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  CIVIC CHAMBERS, 2:30 PM

Tunua Thrash-Ntuk, Chair
Daryl Supernaw, Vice Chair
Dr. Joni Ricks-Oddie, Member

  Members of the public have the option to submit online public comments and email
  comments to cityclerk@longbeach.gov

  Please view the meeting from your computer, tablet, or smartphone via:
  https://longbeach.primegov.com/public/portal?fromiframe=true

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  26-55154  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Housing and Public Health
  Committee meeting of Tuesday, April 7, 2026.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  26-55155  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Long Beach
  Community Land Trust regarding the operational framework of Community Land
  Trusts, including their role in preserving affordable housing stock, and potential
  collaborative opportunities within the City.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  26-55156  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation from the Community
  Development Department providing an update on ongoing community outreach
  related to the City’s Just Cause policy framework considerations.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Housing and Public Health Committee on non-agenda items. Each
speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ADJOURNMENT

I, Jonathan Nagayama, City Clerk Analyst, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours
prior to the meeting.
